card.name: End of drug names before dosage form
card.fires_on: The last piece of a drug or drug-class name, such as the 'ide' in Oxycodone Hydrochloride or 'iral' in antiviral, right before the next word like Oral Solution or Agents.

modes.label: Salt name ending
modes.description: The 'ide' that completes Hydrochloride in Oxycodone Hydrochloride Oral Solution.
modes.example: Avoid use of Oxycodone Hydrochlor<<ide>> Oral Solution in patients with circulatory shock

modes.label: Antiviral class
modes.description: The ending of antiviral or an adjacent word in a drug-class heading.

modes.label: Inhalation product
modes.description: The ending of aerosol in an inhaler product name.
modes.example: ipratropium bromide HFA inhalation aeros<<ol>> before using for the first time
